evidence.description: Epistemic level the component itself claims for its outputs.  The validation engine may *lower* this; it can never be raised here.

metrics.description: Metrics published by the component (wall time, iterations, residuals…).

request_hash.description: Hash of the request that produced this result.

warnings.description: Free-form warnings (e.g. "left validity domain at t=42s").

EvidenceLevel.description: Epistemic status of a result or claim.

oneOf.description: A conjecture that has not been checked by any means.
Obtained by direct computation from a closed-form or exact method (e.g. analytic formula, exact arithmetic, deterministic algorithm).
Obtained by numerical simulation of a model.  Subject to model error and numerical error.
Compared against experimental / observational reference data within a declared tolerance.
Backed by a machine-checked or peer-reviewed mathematical proof.
